comment: On WDT status bit 0x80, writes keyed value 0xa53c then toggles PBDR bit15. Matches external-watchdog heartbeat idiom documented by npkern; external chip/pin routing remains unverified. Boot-path evidence, not yet the running-engine heartbeat.
Same PB15 toggle with a saturating event counter. Existing name checkWatchdogForOverflowandReset overstates reset behavior: the visible action is servicing/toggling, not issuing a reset.

0x3922 reads SR; saves SR&0xf0; if requested mask is greater, delay-slot instruction 0x392c loads argument into SR. Raw C omits this side effect. This is not a pure function despite the exported C body.
20 NOP instructions before RTS, plus one delay-slot NOP. Raw C returns immediately because timing has no C-level side effect; preserve this distinction when analyzing peripheral timing.

Sets SCI_SMR0=0x80, BRR0=4, adjusts SCR0 and pin configuration, exchanges combined RAM command bytes via 0x71ea, restores SR through tail jump. Calls 0x3920 with 0xb0, so transfer can run with mask raised to interrupt level 11. Endpoint purpose is not confirmed.

SCI0 transmit/receive with GPIO select at 0xfffff764 bit0. At 0x721e..0x7226 waits for SCI_SSR0 bit0x40 with no software timeout or watchdog service inside the loop. Clock-synchronous configuration comes from caller 0x7188. Not proof of the reported reset; missing external response alone need not prevent internally clocked receive completion.

Replaces command bits under mask 0x38, then calls 0x7188. Supersedes the inherited interpretation ignitionCoilPulse as a descriptive alias: this routine sends a serial command, not a direct coil pulse. Knock-front-end association is a hypothesis, not established chip identity.

Descriptor access matches ScoobyRom Denso layout: type byte +2, optional scale +12 and offset +16; this ROM uses indirect interpolation dispatch. Raw signature/register-derived temporaries remain unresolved. Layout compatibility does not transfer Subaru table names or units.
Descriptor access matches ScoobyRom Denso layout: type byte +16, optional scale +20 and offset +24. This is structural evidence, not proof of calibration meaning or complete ABI recovery.
